scenarios.title: 前台办理入住
scenarios.setting: 你到酒店前台，报预订姓氏、交护照，问 Wi‑Fi 和房卡。

lines.en: I'd like to check in, please.
lines.speak: I'd like to check in, please.

lines.en: Sure. Do you have a reservation?
lines.speak: Sure. Do you have a reservation?

lines.en: Yes. I have a reservation under Wang. Here's my passport.
lines.zh: 有，预订姓王。这是我的护照。
lines.speak: Yes. I have a reservation under Wang. Here's my passport.

lines.en: Here's your key card. Enjoy your stay.
lines.zh: 这是您的房卡。祝您入住愉快。
lines.speak: Here's your key card. Enjoy your stay.

scenarios.title: 退房并寄存行李
scenarios.setting: 你早上退房，确认退房时间，要收据，并请前台暂时寄存行李。

lines.en: I'd like to check out, please.
lines.speak: I'd like to check out, please.

lines.en: Can you hold my luggage until three?
lines.zh: 能帮我把行李存到三点吗？
lines.speak: Can you hold my luggage until three?

lines.en: Could I have a receipt, please?
lines.speak: Could I have a receipt, please?
